verdict.rationale: Termius is clearly an SSH client with key management (passphrase-protected keys, encrypted storage, FIDO2/biometric auth) per termius-docs-12/13/14, implying core SSH key-based authentication, but no evidence explicitly confirms support for Ed25519, ECDSA, or RSA key types specifically. Missing for 10: explicit documentation naming supported key algorithms (Ed25519/ECDSA/RSA), and independent confirmation of successful connections using each key type.
